            AI Supremacy 

SubscribeSign in🎈 Guest PostsWhat Rivian's AI & Autonomy Growth Signals 

The smart car era is finally starting to manifest. Rivian's AI and autonomy pivot impresses me. 

Michael Spencer and Daniel Abreu MarquesMar 04, 2026∙ Paid12016ShareRivian’s R2 is finally coming. Today something a little bit different. I’m a big fan of journalists who cover the AV sector. I’ve been watching the smart car sector for what feels like decades. From Apple’s failure to build a smart car to Xiaomi’s success, it’s been quite a journey. In the later half of the 2020s, there’s finally light at the other end of the tunnel. Advanced autonomy, improved sensors, millions of miles more experience, integrated software and embedded AI have all improved considerably in the last decade. 

That world of robots, delivery drones, robo-taxis and consumer ambient intelligence: well, it’s finally coming. 

A Physical AI Wave Begins in 2027 

I’m hugely optimistic about the coming Physical AI wave. When Rivian had their AI & autonomy day back in December, 2025 I had the distinct impression this is what the entire world is heading towards. The physical AI devices of 2027, emphasis on humanoid robotics, and the evolution of autonomous vehicles finally will appear tangible by the end of the decade. 

Rivian’s CEO also recently appears on the No Priors Podcast, a fairly good AI startup podcast. It’s been a long road for Rivian but I see them turning the corner this year where the company has moved from being a niche, high-end truck maker to a serious mass-market contender, primarily driven by the launch of the R2 platform. I’ve always liked the look of their vehicles but finally they are more affordable too, the Rivian R2 is a new, more affordable midsize electric SUV built on a dedicated, highly efficient, and compact platform, starting around $45,000.

But it’s the AI & Autonomous work they are doing that is the deal maker for me. 

Video: The Leap | Autonomy & AI Day | Rivian - YouTube. 

Autonomous Vehicles are Closer to Mainstream Adoption 

Rivian is one of the most promising EV startups in the U.S., at a major turning point this year in 2026 as they pivot more to AI and autonomy, which I find fascinating. They are backed by the likes of Amazon and Volkswagen Group and I believe will become a major alternative to Tesla even as the demand for electric vehicles has waned. I more or less see 2027 as the date civilization enters the age of Physical AI and I think Rivian represents an interesting case study in its emergence. 

As Waymo, the leading AV moonshot by Google expands, it’s an exciting time in autonomous vehicle evolution. 

Axios. I watched the entire Rivian AI and Autonomy Day live, and I was impressed. I asked Daniel Abreu Marques of the Newsletter The AV Market Strategic, for his insights on Rivian and a deep dive on their AI & Autonomy strategy. 

The AV Market Strategist 

If you are interested in smart car developments, this is a great publication. Autonomous vehicles are improving and expanding to more cities near you. 

It’s, finally happening.
